about.text: I'm Steven Joe T. Reyes, a first-year DCT student from Ilocos Sur. I learn by shipping real projects — panels, dashboards, and systems people actually use. My path: BSIT → Master's Degree → Work.
about.title: Who I Am?

projects.description: Multi-store POS + inventory SaaS for sari-sari stores and small retailers: cashier with discounts and printable receipts, batch & expiry tracking, QR/barcode scanning, suppliers and receivings, sales & inventory reports, per-store staff with roles and store codes, subscription plans (Free / Pro / Business), notifications, light & dark modes, and a platform admin console.
projects.title: Tienda - Inventory Management System - 2026

projects.description: Social media services platform with ordering, notifications, service analytics, admin tools, and a responsive interface.
projects.title: Smmsocialpulse - 2025

projects.description: Northern Philippines commute and student app: jeepney/bus trip planner with fare calculator (LTFRB rates), 9,861-barangay search, live GPS navigation, class schedules, tasks, allowance tracker, reviewers and marketplace. Built as a Firebase PWA, targeting Google Play in December 2026.
projects.title: SkwelaGo - 2026

projects.description: AI photo enhancer website: upload a normal photo and enhance it to HD / HD+ / 4K / Ultra HD with a before-after slider. Wink Studio-style dark dashboard with an on-device enhance fallback and an optional Replicate Real-ESRGAN cloud backend.
projects.title: PicSmooth Studio - 2026

projects.description: Complete barangay management system: login with OTP, dashboard, resident records, officials, blotter, calendar, printable certificates, business permits, budgeting with purpose tracking, assembly records, and reports. Built in two versions — PHP 8 + MySQL for hosting, and a static Netlify version. Live demo login: admin@barangay.local / password123
projects.title: Barangay Management System - 2026

projects.description: Classroom attendance dashboard for tracking student presence, rosters, and day-to-day classroom monitoring.
projects.title: Student Attendance Monitor - 2026

projects.description: Web hosting company website with real multi-page navigation: home, pricing, features, about and contact, domain search, hosting plans and a client-area style flow — every button does a real action, no dead links.
projects.title: StevenHost - 2026

projects.description: My own SMS provider platform: customers register, top up credits, and send SMS from the web or through their own API key — bulk sending, contacts, a shared sender-name pool, and a full admin console for top-up approvals and monitoring. Sending runs through the Semaphore API under the SMMSOFT sender name.
projects.title: SMMSOFT - SMS Gateway - 2026
